data.description:
## Context
The current review process reviews a single large PR when an epic merges to main. For large epics (4000+ changed lines), this oversized review surface degrades reviewer quality — findings become less precise and more hallucination-prone. Splitting into per-story PRs creates smaller, focused review surfaces. An attestation mechanism records which story increments have passed review, enabling the final merge to skip re-reviewing already-attested code.
